questions.text:
Identify the language generated by the following grammar, where S is start variable.
S[latex]\rightarrow[/latex] XY
X[latex]\rightarrow[/latex] aX|a
Y [latex]\rightarrow[/latex]aYb|[latex]\in[/latex]
questions.solution:
X gives [latex]a^k[/latex] with k [latex]\ge[/latex] 1; Y gives [latex]a^nb^n[/latex] with n [latex]\ge[/latex] 0. Together: [latex]a^{k+n}b^n[/latex], so the a's are strictly more than the b's.

Answer: [latex]\{a^mb^n\mid m \gt n,\ n\ge0\}[/latex]

questions.text:
An ER model of a database consists of entity types A and B. These are connected by a
relationship R which does not have its own attribute. Under which one of the following
conditions, can the relational table for R be merged with that of A?
questions.solution:
If R is many-to-one from A to B and A participates totally, each A-tuple is related to exactly one B-tuple. So B's key can be stored as a column (foreign key) in A's table without NULLs or repeats.

Answer: Relationship R is many-to-one and the participation of A in R is total

Click here for detail solution by gateoverflow
options: Relationship R is one-to-many and the participation of A in R is total
Relationship R is one-to-many and the participation of A in R is partial
Relationship R is many-to one and the participation of A in R is total
Relationship R is many-to one and the participation of A in R is partial

questions.text:
Consider socket API on a Linux machine that supports connected UDP sockets. A connected UDP socket is a UDP socket on which connect function has already been called. Which of the following statements is/are CORRECT ?
I. A connected UDP socket can be used to communicate with multiple peers simultaneously.
II. A process can successfully call connect function again for an already connected UDP socket.
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- I: a connected UDP socket is tied to one peer; datagrams from others are ignored False
- II: calling connect again on a UDP socket is allowed (to change the peer or disconnect) True

Answer: II only

questions.text:
Consider the following tables T1 and T2.

In table T1, P is the primary key and Q is the foreign key referencing R in table T2 with ondelete cascade and on-update cascade. In table T2, R is the primary key and S is the foreign key referencing P in table T1 on-delete set NULL and on-update cascade. In order to delete record (3,8) from table T1, the number of additional records that need to be deleted from table T1 is _____.
questions.solution:
Deleting (3, 8) from T1: T2's S references T1.P with ON DELETE SET NULL, so the T2 row (8, 3) just gets S = NULL. No T2 row is deleted, so nothing cascades back into T1.

Answer: 0

questions.text:
The maximum number of IPv4 router addresses that can be listed in the record route (RR)
option field of an IPv4 header is _________.
questions.solution:
IPv4 options can be at most 40 bytes. Record Route uses 3 bytes (type, length, pointer); the remaining 37 bytes hold 4-byte addresses: [latex]\lfloor37/4\rfloor=9[/latex].

Answer: 9
